## KEY POINT

Although rest periods of 60 to 90 seconds induce a seemingly favorable metabolic environment for achieving hypertrophy, research indicates that resting at least 2 minutes between sets provides a hypertrophic advantage compared to shorter rest periods because of the ability to maintain greater volume load.
